## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Outcome:** The floating bar's own geometry and reserved space check out. Popout panels and notification toasts elsewhere in the shell still place themselves as if the bar were flush against the screen edge, so they misalign once floating is on. Two documentation corrections and one large-gap limit follow.

**Verified:**
- With the feature off (`bar.floating` unset and no theme margin, or `false` over a theme margin), the bar's layer-surface box, reserved space, hidden parking, square corners, transparent-text sampling crop and drag mapping match the base for all four positions.
- Floating in the gap: Hyprland 0.56.2 reserves the exclusive zone plus the anchored margin (`src/render/Renderer.cpp`), so a zone of `barSize - m` reserves exactly `barSize`. With uniform or per-side `gaps_out`, toggling floating leaves the work area unchanged and the bar ends line up with the windows.
- The `css` field of `hyprctl -j getoption general:gaps_out` is parsed per side, and the `margin`/`radius` theme keys handle zero, negative, unit-suffixed and malformed values.
- `bar-test.sh` and `bar-text-color-test.sh` pass on the PR head, and the new cases fail against the base code.

### Popout panels and notification toasts ignore the bar margin

`shell/Ui/KeyboardPanel.qml` (unchanged by this PR) maps the clicked icon into the bar window's local coordinates, uses that as a screen coordinate, and places the card `barH + gap` from the screen edge (`anchorScreenPos`, `cardOrigin`). Its click forwarding (`inBarRegion`, `barPoint`, `_barStripSize`) makes the same assumption. Toast clearance in `shell/plugins/notifications/Service.qml` is `barSize + Style.gapsOut`, with no margin term. `KeyboardPanel` backs the audio, network, bluetooth, power, clock and several other bar panels. `PopupCard.qml` anchors to the bar window itself and is not affected.

Top bar, 26 px, stock `gaps_out = 10`, values evaluated from the production expressions (not observed on screen):

```text
                      bar (y)    card / toast top (y)   card vs icon centre
flush (control)       0..26      31  (5 px gap)         centred
floating, in gap      5..31      31  (touching)         about 10 px left
floating, margin=10   10..36     31  (5 px overlap)     about 10 px left
```

Bottom, left and right bars show the same pattern on their own axes. With a panel open, a click on the bar is forwarded with the same offset, so it can reach a neighbouring widget, or land outside the recognised bar strip and close the panel instead.

**Impact:** Only with floating enabled, so existing setups are unchanged. When it is on, every popout opened from the bar is off-centre and touches or overlaps the bar, toasts do the same, and forwarded clicks can hit the wrong widget.

**Suggested change:** Expose the bar's `barMargins` through the bar and add them where `KeyboardPanel` converts between bar and screen coordinates (`anchorScreenPos`/`cardOrigin`, `barPoint`, `_barStripSize`) and to the toast `barClearance`, as the PR already does for drag mapping and text sampling.

### Documentation

**Suggested change:** `docs/omarchy-shell.md` says to turn the feature on with `omarchy bar floating true`, but `bin/omarchy-bar` at this head has no `floating` command (`omarchy-bar: unknown command: floating`). The command arrives with #13140. Dropping it here, or noting that dependency, would keep the docs accurate for this PR alone.

**Suggested change:** The example `margin = "4 8"   # 4 from the anchored edge, 8 at the two ends` holds only for top and bottom bars. `"Y X"` expands to 4 top/bottom and 8 left/right, so a left or right bar gets 8 at its anchored edge and 4 at its ends. A comment such as `# 4 above and below, 8 left and right` is accurate for every position.

**Large `gaps_out` note:** The in-gap zone is clamped with `Math.max(1, barSize - m)`. Once half of `gaps_out` reaches the bar thickness (`gaps_out` of 51 or more for a 26 px top bar), the floating bar reserves `m + 1` instead of `barSize`, so toggling floating does move windows: `gaps_out = 80` reserves 41 px instead of 26. The docs state window stability without that condition; a short qualifier would cover it.

**Optional test improvement:** Most of the new `bar-test.sh` checks match `Bar.qml`/`Style.qml` source text. In diagnostic copies of the head, five realistic breakages still passed the suite: dropping the per-side `gaps_out` parse, not insetting the bar ends, never applying the radius, never reading `bar.floating`, and painting the background on the window again (square corners). A behaviour-preserving rewrite of the exclusive-zone expression failed it. Moving the window margin and zone wiring into `BarModel` functions with value assertions, plus a value test for the `gaps_out` JSON parse, would let the tests follow behaviour rather than wording.
